name: Conformance level
description: The level of gov-schema a publisher has finished. There are three levels, so a government can publish something useful right away instead of finishing every field on day one. gov-schema checks each claim — it never just takes your word for it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Core
hasDefinedTerm.description: Has a Jurisdiction and an Organization, kept separate, each with its own @id and at least one identifier.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Standard
hasDefinedTerm.description: Meets Core, fills in every required field for each profile you use, makes every reference resolve, and places every organization in the territorial hierarchy.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Extended
hasDefinedTerm.description: Meets Standard, adds the recommended optional fields, and links to the source standard the data comes from in a form a computer can read.
